subject: Partner SI joint workshop — architecture & marketplace integration
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@integrix.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Partner SI joint workshop — architecture & marketplace integration

Tom / Integrix team,

Thanks again for the conversation last week. As discussed, we'd like to run a focused technical workshop to align on architecture, deployment topology for the RedBox connector, and the AWS Marketplace listing flow. Goals for the session:
- Validate network/VPC and IAM assumptions for a proof-of-concept
- Walk through the integration points for marketplace procurement and licensing
- Identify test data needs and success criteria for a technical POC

Proposed duration: 2.5 hours (deep-dive + Q&A). Suggested slots (PT):
- Thu May 15 — 10:00–12:30
- Fri May 16 — 09:00–11:30

I've attached an initial agenda (WorkshopAgenda-v3.pdf) and a short checklist for network prep. Can you confirm which slot works for your team and whether the AWS marketplace rep (if available) should be on the call?

Attendees from Redwood (planned): Camila (Partner Lead), Aisha (SRE/solutions), Vivek (SE), Laura (Security). Please add any additional names.

If a different day/time is easier we can pivot — main priority is to get the architecture diagram and network details in front of the SI and AWS rep.

Thanks,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez | Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

Attachments: WorkshopAgenda-v3.pdf
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@integrix.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: partners@integrix.com, Sarah Li <sli@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 14:32:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Partner SI joint workshop — architecture & marketplace integration

Sergio,

Thanks — appreciate the agenda. Thu May 15 at 10:00 PT should work for the core Integrix engineering team (Tom, Lina, and our marketplace lead). Quick notes from our side before we lock: 
- Would like to cover expected call flows for procurement (license activation webhook).
- We'll need a network diagram showing any egress endpoints/redwood-managed endpoints and ports (UDP/UDP?) — we can take a first pass but would prefer to review yours live.
- Sarah from the AWS marketplace team is copied. She mentioned she may only be available on Fri May 16; if AWS needs to be present for the procurement walkthrough we can do Fri instead.

Can we tentatively pencil Thu 10:00 PT and convert to Fri only if Sarah confirms Fri as the required slot? Also please share any pre-read on required VPC peering or private link options.

Regards,
Tom Reynolds
Lead Solutions Architect, Integrix Cloud
Tom.Reynolds@integrix.com

On Mon, May 12, 2025 at 10:08 AM Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai> wrote:
> [see above]
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@integrix.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner SI joint workshop — architecture & marketplace integration

Tom — thanks for the quick response. We can do Thu May 15 at 10:00 PT on Redwood's side. A few coordination items so the call is productive:

1) Updated agenda: I shortened the procurement slot and added a breakout for testing/POC success criteria (attached: WorkshopAgenda-v3.pdf — version note included in the footer).
2) Pre-reads: Sergio, I attached a one-page network prerequisites list and a small template for attendee roles we need (owner, infra SME, procurement).
3) Request: can Integrix confirm the list of attendees and whether Lina will bring the marketplace integration engineer who owns the webhook work?

Vivek and Aisha will cover: runtime requirements, KV caching behavior for multi-tenant setups, and how quantization profiles affect inference latency. Laura will join for a short security checklist review but requested the diagram in message 4 below before she does a deeper review.

If Tom or Integrix prefer Fri for full AWS attendance, please confirm by EOD today. Otherwise we will send a calendar invite for Thu May 15 10:00–12:30 PT.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes | Partner Solutions
camila_reyes@redwood.ai

Attachments: WorkshopAgenda-v3.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@integrix.com>
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner SI joint workshop — architecture & marketplace integration

Quick security note before the workshop:

Thanks team. For Laura/Redwood security review we need:
- High-level architecture diagram showing data flow, where logs are retained, and which endpoints will handle user-provided data (please attach NetworkDiagram.png).
- Confirmation of encryption in transit and at rest for any artifacts used in the POC.
- Expected retention policy for KV cache and any customer-provided artifacts.
- Contact for SOC2/ISO evidence if Integrix will be hosting any demo data on their account.

I've attached a short SecurityChecklist.xlsx to help Integrix map answers to the agenda items. If you can drop the diagram and a short answers doc into the shared drive link ahead of the workshop it will speed the review.

Laura Bennett
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments: SecurityChecklist.xlsx
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>

Cc: Sarah Li <sli@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed — May 15 workshop (10:00 PT) + pre-read links

All,

Thanks for the quick replies — confirmed Thu May 15, 10:00–12:30 PT. Camila will send the calendar invite in a minute with conferencing details. Action items going into the workshop: 
- Integrix: please upload the NetworkDiagram.png and a short answers doc addressing the SecurityChecklist.xlsx into the shared drive folder (link below) by EOD May 14.
- AWS (Sarah): if you can confirm whether you want the procurement slot extended to 45min, let us know — otherwise we'll keep 30min and record action items.
- Redwood: Vivek & Aisha will prepare a 25-minute runtime/latency demo with quantization tradeoffs; Laura will prepare a 10-minute security summary.

Shared assets: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleWorkshopMaterials
HubSpot deal: RDW-2025-1347
Docs for signature: https://app.hellosign.com/s/docs/example-docusign-link

Attachments included for pre-read: WorkshopAgenda-v3.pdf, SecurityChecklist.xlsx

See you Thursday — Sergio
